canon.name: Haunted House
canon.frame: a first person view walking through a haunted house at night, filmed at eye height by a steady handheld camera with a natural lens, each room seen in depth with its walls, floor and ceiling, lit by dripping candles and blue moonlight
canon.still: The camera stands still at eye height in the middle of the room for the whole clip while candle flames flicker, thin mist curls across the floor and lightning flashes once at a window
canon.approach: In the first half second, the camera swings toward {thing} and leans in
canon.arrive: the doors fly open in a howling gust of mist and the camera rushes through into {thing}
canon.settle: In the last second, the camera steps back and comes to rest at eye height in the middle of the room, a clear steady view of the whole room with everything in it
canon.ambient: Wind howls around an old house, rain lashes the windows, candles sputter and floorboards creak
canon.selectSound: Slow footsteps creak across old floorboards
canon.lettering: small engraved Victorian serif in tarnished brass, Title Case
canon.style: 35mm horror film, cold blues and candle orange

ahead.phrase: On the far wall straight ahead

middle.phrase: In the middle of the room

air.phrase: Floating in the air in the middle of the room

floor.phrase: On the floor in the near foreground

ladder.mood: a creaky old haunted house at night, eerie and quiet, things just starting to stir
the house is openly haunted and its ghosts are showing off
ladder.ambient: Cold white mist pours across the floor and swirls around the furniture
ladder.sound: A long ghostly moan drifts down from somewhere upstairs

ladder.mood: objects fly, portraits move and ghosts pop out of every room
ladder.ambient: Small objects float slowly in the air above every table and shelf
ladder.sound: Heavy chains rattle and drag inside the walls

ladder.mood: the ghosts are competing to scare the visitor and getting theatrical
ladder.ambient: Pale glowing ghosts peek around the doorframes and drift past in the background
ladder.sound: A pipe organ somewhere in the house blasts one huge dramatic chord

ladder.mood: the whole house is alive, walls breathing and furniture walking
ladder.ambient: The walls slowly swell in and out like breathing and lightning flashes nonstop
ladder.sound: Thunder cracks overhead and the whole house lets out a deep groan

ladder.mood: the ghosts crown the visitor the new master of the house in a howling ceremony
ladder.ambient: Glowing ghosts bow in a wide ring around the camera under swirling green candlelight
ladder.sound: A choir of ghosts howls a triumphant fanfare
